name: The Game Jam
description: Five genres, one prompt each: a Flappy Bird remake, a Command & Conquer-style RTS, a top-down action RPG, a zombie survival game with base building and a racer, each built as one self-contained web page, played by a scripted player in a headless browser and rated by a cross-vendor judge panel that weights creativity most. Expensive (every game is up to 64,000 output tokens), so it runs once per model by default; check the Cost Planner first.
